title: English Practice Quiz 0869
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Despite of the rain, we continued
Despite it was raining, we continued
questions.explanation: Despite is followed by a noun phrase, not of.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage: The manager insisted that the report ___ submitted today.
questions.explanation: Formal subjunctive usage follows insist that with the base form be.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage: Ambiguous means:
options: having more than one possible meaning
questions.explanation: Ambiguous means open to more than one interpretation.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage: No sooner had the guard arrived ___ the alarm sounded.
questions.explanation: The standard construction is no sooner...than.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage: The instructions were so ___ that everyone understood them.
questions.explanation: Explicit means stated clearly and in detail.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage: The new policy will ___ all departments.
questions.explanation: Affect is the verb meaning influence.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage: Had I known about the change, I ___ earlier.
questions.explanation: This inverted third conditional uses would have plus past participle.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage: To put something into perspective means to:
options: consider it in relation to other facts
questions.explanation: It means evaluate something in a broader context.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence:
options: The supervisor said, Please wait here.
questions.explanation: The introductory clause takes a comma and the quoted sentence ends inside the quotation marks.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage: A plausible explanation is:
questions.explanation: Plausible means seeming reasonable or probable.
